scopeNote: Regular-season decided weeks only, 2018 on. Actual = points from the started lineup; optimal = best legal lineup from the same weekly roster. Efficiency = actual / optimal.

winnableLosses.scopeNote: Decided regular-season losses since 2018 where the loser's optimal lineup outscores the winner's actual score. Ties excluded; playoffs excluded.

managerWinsAdded.scopeNote: Stolen wins minus avoidable losses since 2018. Expected = optimal lineup times the league-week-average efficiency (total actual over total optimal across included owners that week, reusing the same per-team actual/optimal as sit-start). Strict inequalities; ties excluded; playoffs excluded.
